frontier.hypothesis: Cluster 1 closes when v1 loses $2 to the table-pointer chain (H1, ~16 of 20)

frontier.hypothesis: Cluster 2 closes by merging a0_58 and v1_58 into ONE reused variable loaded twice from s0+0x58 (H2, 4 of 20)
frontier.mechanism: 4-ref reused pseudo outranks a1_val in allocno priority, winning $4 as in target (variable-reuse family, SOTN-sanctioned)
frontier.next_probe: p = *(s32*)(s0+0x58); ... *(u8*)p ...; p = *(s32*)(s0+0x58); *(u8*)(p+2) — verify insn count stays 158 and cluster-2 diff flips

frontier.next_probe: no separate probe — verify automatically when H1 lands
